claim: NEAR-USD 1-minute candle high reaches or exceeds 5.00 USD on both Coinbase and Kraken in the same 5-minute window before 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z.

elements.q: Do the exhibits show a Coinbase NEAR-USD candle with high >= 5.00 and a Kraken NEARUSD candle with high >= 5.00 in the same 5-minute window before 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z?

custom_definitions: A wick: the candle HIGH counts, not the close.
Only USD pairs on the named venues count; aggregators (CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap) are never eligible; market cap and FDV are not resolvable in v1 (supply figures are aggregator-defined).
Thin-book risk: the same-5-minute-window two-venue rule closes single-venue manipulation; a one-venue print never fires.
Burden of proof is on YES: an unproven or ambiguous element resolves NO.
Early resolution: YES may be declared at the first qualifying event; NO only at/after the deadline.
Fallback: a blocked, rate-limited or unreachable source is COULDNT_CHECK (never NO); the recovery ladder and the listed fallback source apply, then VOID.
